purpose: Machine-readable routing index for repeated AI-assisted development. Canonical state is not duplicated here.

directories.src: canonical editable source/evidence grouped by module
directories.runtime: machine-readable active runtime metadata and verified fast indexes
directories.artifacts/runtime_cache: content-addressed exact DLL bytes for stable packaging and rollback
directories.artifacts: recovery, binary audits and deterministic reproducers
directories.archives: deprecated/intermediate archive experiments; do not scan by default
directories.tools: verification, build, packaging and maintenance scripts

rules: AGENTS.md defines the AI operating contract
runtime/current.json decides the active stack and canonical source provenance
work must contain current main before development
normal multi-file changes should be one Git tree commit
TEST candidates may compile changed source
STABLE packages must use exact accepted bytes, never an unchecked rebuild
stable promotion must pass Pre-promote stable on the exact promote/** SHA before main moves
promote accepted changes from a clean main-based tree, not the entire accumulated work branch
run source metadata sync/check before stable promotion
final runnable ZIPs must pass tools/verify_candidate_package.py
AI owns routine GitHub housekeeping
never mix TBC/Wrath/Retail assumptions into build 5875 code
respect explicitly selected development branch and check live GitHub HEAD before writing
route new features via active experiment ownership and dependencies; keep parallel and work distinct
ledger test/package evidence must identify exact commit; unknown results remain null
parallel is an integration/test trunk; unproven native or multi-file work preflights on feature/** first

feature -> parallel integration uses optimistic CAS: after exact feature preflight PASS, re-read current parallel HEAD, create one merge commit whose first parent is that exact HEAD and second parent is the exact feature SHA, then update parallel with force=false; if parallel moved or the ref update is rejected, discard the merge commit, re-run preflight against the new HEAD and retry

parallel-testpoint is the frozen user-delivery pointer; it may point only at an exact parallel commit whose required STANDARD/ECONOMY workflow, FINAL_PACKAGE/provenance and relevant artifact gates have passed
do not advance parallel-testpoint merely because parallel moved; keep the issued test SHA frozen until its gameplay result is recorded or the user explicitly supersedes that test point
updater delivery resolves the desired SHA from parallel-testpoint but consumes workflow artifacts whose original head_branch remains parallel, preserving exact build provenance
freeze an issued test artifact by exact branch and SHA until its gameplay result is recorded
batch exact-SHA workflow checks on the success path; inspect jobs/steps/logs only for failures or blockers; optimize end-to-end latency without weakening gates
read compact experiment index and live branch refs before module-source analysis; full experiment ledger is evidence/detail fallback
use verified runtime/ai_startup_snapshot.json fast path for eligible tasks; any identity mismatch or ambiguity falls back to the canonical five-file startup

for long-running ChatGPT tasks, proactively send concise truthful progress updates during active work; aim to avoid more than about 60 seconds of silence when the chat surface permits, without issuing extra GitHub/CI calls solely to create a ping

verification.method: compare snapshot git_blob_sha1 values with Git tree metadata from the same live selected-branch HEAD

eligible_tasks: ordinary implementation on work, parallel or feature/**
CI/status follow-up where startup authority files are unchanged
full_startup_required_for: editing any startup source file, snapshot or generator
recovery after unknown or ambiguous write/transport state
snapshot missing, stale, mismatched or unverifiable
authority or branch ambiguity not resolved by compact state
after_verified_snapshot: query live relevant branch HEADs before writes
read only module/dependency files needed for the task
invariants: snapshot is a generated cache; canonical files and live GitHub state remain authoritative
explicit parallel stays parallel and main remains accepted stable only
unproven native or multi-file parallel changes start on feature/**
one logical iteration uses one coherent commit when possible
never force-push or destructively reset unique work
exact-SHA CI/package gates and updater delivery rules are unchanged
fast startup never weakens runtime, package, provenance or promotion verification
parallel integration is compare-and-swap: exact preflighted feature SHA plus current parallel parent, force=false ref update, retry from fresh HEAD on rejection
parallel-testpoint is a frozen delivery pointer and may advance only to a fully verified exact parallel SHA; development may continue independently on parallel

for long-running ChatGPT tasks, proactively send concise truthful progress updates during active work; aim to avoid more than about 60 seconds of silence when the chat surface permits, without issuing extra GitHub/CI calls solely to create a ping
